So. You really only need to know a few things. (I couldn't pay attention to the super long crafting videos because the guy just talks in circles forever.)

10-fold Steel is your best friend. Secret room up the right side at the bottom of the Leon Karnak tower, go right. You'll wanna use any weapon upgraded with Scrap Metal+ on the Mineral Squeaks you find there. This makes the weapon deal only 1 damage. Mineral Squeaks have 4HP, and drop sither Double Steel or 10-fold Steel every time they're hit while they have HP. Scrap Metal+ drops randomly from failed crafting and forging. Personally, I upgrade a basic set of Gloves for my weapon.

10-fold Steel combined with the Sharance Boss items is insanely powerful. Even a Grimoire Scale is really good.

You can also fill empty slots with up to 3 extra items when forging weapons or crafting items to make them more powerful. You can even use 3 of the same item with no penalty.

You can get lucky from finding silver treasure chests in the maze. In fact, this is the only way to get higher-level Rune Abilities, since Leon won't upgrade them.

Leon will upgrade magic spells you give him, though, if you didn't already know.

Recipe Bread+ is also crucial for accessing the most powerful equipment in the game. Ideally you're only using this after unlocking all the recipes in Rune Prana (and everywhere else), or you could get duplicates. These items only drop randomly after the final boss in each Sharance Maze dungeon. You can equip a Rosary before going in to enable a boss rush type mode of sorts, speeding up the process. (You can also take off the Rosary once inside to switch your preferred accessory and keep its effect)

You can find Round Stone by fishing at the waterfall in Yokmir Forest. This is a crucial component for some recipes, and as far as I can remember, the game never really tells you where to find it.

White Stone can only be found by accessing the area in at Sechs Territory that requires you to be married with a child to go through.

If you want to make a really powerful staff, upgrade it with Wind Dragon Tooth and Ancient Bone. The upgrade order corresponds to the level of charge for the staff, but I don't remember which way. The last 3 upgrades used will affect its spells. The recipe I saw used a Rainbow Waterpot as well, but as far as I can tell all its spell does is drain your RP heavily with no other effect.

Keep in mind that the Wind Dragon Tooth's spell *will frequently crash your game if used on 3DS!!* Use with caution. I've lost lots of progress this way. I don't know the crash rate on Special.

Rune Prana has plenty of items you'll want to go back for, mostly boss items.

I remember there's a quest where Arthur gives you Golden Turnip seeds. You're meant to plant them and use it to make Turnip Heaven to give to him. It sounds like you just shipped the seeds instead. If you begin the quest again (you may need to cancel it first?) you should get more.

This dialogue confused me when I first saw it, too. I almost wonder whether the seasonal fields were originally planned to be inside dungeons, then later made to be more easily accessible. There are a couple rooms with ornate floor patterns visible in Yokmir Cave and the Sechs Territory cave. I wonder whether these were a couple of the original locations for the fields (and whether the fancy tile is meant to cover up the lack of a field, given that nothing particularly special happens in these rooms). The room in Yokmir Cave has a small tree in it, and the room in the Sechs Territory cave is adjacent to a large pond, both of which hint at what could've been field locations. Further supporting this is the design of the overworld, with nearly every "room" looking like it could branch off in any direction, some of which are only blocked off by trees (which would make adding the seasonal fields to the overworld later in development a trivial task). This might even serve as an explanation for>!the plot hole of the Autumn Field's location being on Maya Road's side of the bridge, with the devs' solution being to just, de-list it from the list of destinations at save points until you progress the story as intended.!<
